title: Analysis request
description: The HTTP layer separately caps the raw JSON entity at 600,128 bytes. After JSON decoding, the source_code UTF-8 encoding must be no more than 100,000 bytes.

source_code.description: After JSON decoding, application rejects whitespace-only content, UTF-8 encodings over 100,000 bytes, and source with over 2,000 addressable logical lines. It retains the decoded string exactly for source-line and evidence checks.
